title: The Statutory Rates Levied on a Hotel Rate Plans Stay
content:
Which statutory rates are levied on the taxable room money of a Hotel Rate Plans stay turns on whether the reservation records the city the property stands in and on whether the arrival date has already been reached.

## The rule

1. Where the reservation records the city the property stands in and the arrival date has already been reached on the handling date, the statutory rate is the occupancy tax rate together with the city tax rate the plan carries, the two statutory rates being levied together on the same taxable room money.
2. Where the reservation records no city the property stands in and the arrival date has already been reached on the handling date, the statutory rate is the occupancy tax rate alone.
3. In every other case the statutory rate is the occupancy tax rate alone.

The arrival date has already been reached on the handling date when the handling date falls on or after it; a handling date before the arrival date has not reached it.

## The two rates each plan carries

| Rate plan | Occupancy tax, percent | City tax, percent | The two together, percent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 12.5 | 4.0 | 16.5 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 12.5 | 4.0 | 16.5 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 12.5 | 4.0 | 16.5 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 12.5 | 4.0 | 16.5 |
| Member Flex Rate | 12.5 | 4.0 | 16.5 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 12.5 | 4.0 | 16.5 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 12.5 | 4.0 | 16.5 |

## The combinations

| Reservation records the property's city | Arrival date reached on the handling date | Statutory rate |
| --- | --- | --- |
| yes | yes | the occupancy tax rate together with the city tax rate |
| no | yes | the occupancy tax rate alone |
| yes | no | the occupancy tax rate alone |
| no | no | the occupancy tax rate alone |

Only the first row levies both rates.

## Worked on hypothetical figures

Taxable room money of 1,600.00 USD:

- Where the reservation records the property's city and the stay has reached its arrival date, the rate is 16.5 percent levied once on the whole figure, giving 264.00 USD.
- Where the reservation records no city, or where the arrival date has not been reached, the rate is 12.5 percent, giving 200.00 USD.
